verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for a package-manager CLI, but the pack documents neither. The only related item is a note that Bun v1.2 changed the default lockfile format, which is a one-off change note, not a versioned API or a published deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
